title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Jira unreachable; source is the local rfe-snapshot.md (Strategy section used as scope: input-only, image + audio via ASR, one file per conversation, no microphone, no audio output).
The original RFE asks for audio output, multiple images and mixed modalities; the Strategy defers these, so the prototype follows the Strategy.
Model names, file names and the 10 MB limit are mock data (10 MB is a proposed default pending PM confirmation).
The ASR flag on the AI Asset Endpoints table is rendered as an edit-modal checkbox; final UX is an open question owned by UXD.
Processing/progress states (uploading, transcribing) are not modeled as scenarios; Send is a static mock.
